== Notes ==
* Rather than causing the hex cast to fail as the description states, this skill prevents the hex from being applied to the user. 
** Initial effects, such as [[Dark Prison]]'s [[Shadow Step]], ''will'' still take place.
** AoE hexes like [[Rust]] ''will'' still apply normally to all other targets.
** End effects from hexes like [[Shatterstone]] will ''not'' trigger.

== Trivia ==
* This skill was called "Mantra of Hex Shattering" during beta testing.
